# `oaap app artifact`

uploaded packages (RFC-0019).

**Root:** needs `sudo`.

## Usage

```sh
oaap app artifact [--tenant INSTANCE_TENANT]
                         {list,rollback} name [artifact]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `action` | what to do -- see Actions below |
| `name` | instance name |
| `artifact` | retained artifact (default: the one before the running version) |
| `--tenant INSTANCE_TENANT` | tenant label: read the instance as a NAME inside this tenant (also: <tenant>/<name>) |

## Actions

Whether an action needs `sudo` is read from the rule the node enforces, with the other arguments left out (e.g. `node care` reads, `node care measure` needs `sudo`).

| Action | Needs `sudo` |
|---|---|
| `list` | yes |
| `rollback` | yes |
